name: beautyos

scripts.build: npm test && node scripts/check-template-clean.mjs && next build

//build: npm test runs FIRST, before next build even starts. A test file that
fails to load, or a broken assertion, used to reach production silently:
next build compiles TypeScript, which has never once meant the code
works, and Vercel's deploy runs this exact script with no separate gate
on the test suite. That gap cost a real outage - every deploy failing
silently for hours because a test file broke the build and nobody was
watching a check that ran nowhere near the deploy path. Now the test
suite IS the deploy path: a red suite means npm run build exits non-zero
before next build is ever invoked, on a local machine, in CI
(.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the same three steps again for a fast,
separately-attributed failure on a push or PR), and on Vercel.
//check:template: Runs BEFORE next build, on the same command Vercel runs, so it gates the
real deploy path rather than a local habit. It fails the build if
lib/tenantTemplate.ts - which is seeded into every new cosmetician's
account - contains anything resembling one real tenant's data: a UUID, a
phone number, a URL, an image filename, a GreenAPI field, a Supabase
query, or any of the identity-bearing settings keys.
//xlsx: xlsx (SheetJS) is installed from the vendor's own CDN, NOT the npm registry.
The npm package is frozen at 0.18.5 - SheetJS stopped publishing there - and
that version carries two unpatched high-severity advisories with no fix
available on npm: prototype pollution (GHSA-4r6h-8v6p-xvw6) and ReDoS
(GHSA-5pgg-2g8v-p4x9). Both are fixed in 0.20.3, which is what this URL
pins. The tradeoff, accepted deliberately: the Vercel build must be able to
reach cdn.sheetjs.com, and this dependency does not dedupe or audit like a
registry package. Do not 'fix' an install failure by swapping this for
xlsx@0.18.5 from npm - that silently reintroduces both CVEs.
The pin also matters behaviourally: 0.18.5 returned local-time Dates for
date cells and slipped a day. See lib/leads/xlsxImport.ts.
